title: Lead/ Senior Lead Engineer – Multibody Dynamics
experience: 4-10 years’ experience with executing multibody dynamic simulations (both rigid & flex bodies) and structural simulations (linear/non-linear)
qualification: Bachelor's/Master’s degree in mechanical, Aerospace, Automotive, or related engineering discipline
other_details: Responsible for applying Multibody Dynamics simulation techniques to support the design, development & testing of mechanical systems. Involves collaboration with other CAE specialists, design, test & manufacturing engineers. Key tasks include: Perform kinematic and dynamic analysis on complex mechanical systems using Multibody Dynamics (MBD) technique preferably in MSC ADAMS. Develop high-fidelity multibody dynamic models of Nacelle Systems, Landing Gears, Flight Control Mechanisms, Door Systems, etc & correlate simulation models to physical test. Good working knowledge of structural analysis and experienced with related tools (MSc Nastran / Ansys / Abacus). Hands-on experience with simulation tools like MSc ADAMS, MSc Nastran, HyperMesh / MSc Patran / FEMap, Catia V5/V6. Generate reduced-order flex body models using FE software such as MSC Nastran or ANSYS and perform integration for flex body simulations. Perform MBD-Control co-simulation by Integrating MBD model with control model developed in MATLAB/Simulink environments. Basic scripting experience (Python, MATLAB, or similar) for simulation automation and post-processing.
